correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md uses Abrams unsplit cubical model for UConf2(|K4,4|): 28 vertices, 96 vertex-edge cells, 72 disjoint-edge squares. Boundary formulas give ∂1∂2=0. Independent modular matrix reconstruction found ranks 27 and 60 (mod 1009); these alone are lower bounds over Q. Crucially, reviewed verify.py constructs 18 integral disjoint-cycle products, checks they are integral cycles and exhibits 12 linearly independent modulo 1009, furnishing rational kernel dimension ≥12 and hence ∂2 rank ≤60. Therefore b2=12, b1=9 and H2(Z) is torsion-free as a subgroup of free C2. Signed Lefschetz traces are computed from actual permuted cells for all 1152 group elements; the restriction consists of two inequivalent Specht outer products exchanged by part-swap, so Clifford theory yields an irreducible induced 12-dimensional rational module; swap trace 0, positive-degree invariants 0. Independent test was bounded; no H1 integral torsion asserted.
